C-EVENT-TEMPLATES-375.Summary: Visual versioned event templates, canonical extensible fields and source-grounded department selection for editable monthly DOCX.
C-EVENT-TEMPLATES-375.Problem: Monthly plans have fixed print fields and only textual department filtering. Operators cannot configure event fields visually or review an already selected and prefilled departmental document.

Goals.Goal: Configure reusable fields, labels, order, visibility, requiredness and document layout with a live visual preview.
Persist location and typed custom values on canonical events, keeping monthly print overrides separate.
Offer bounded local LLM selection and grounded prefill with deterministic fallback, reviewable reasons and explicit operator acceptance.
Export selected effective fields using an exact template version without duplicating canonical events or calendar entries.

Constraints.Constraint: Authority is the user request and issue 375; exact base main b1e60af895e6918f8938e9c54bf3ee7e2cee76be. Runtime and application version remain unchanged.
Additive migration 033 only. Applied migrations, original files, versions, extracted evidence and historical exports remain unchanged.
Saved template versions and selection results are immutable. ACL and current source fingerprints are rechecked when suggestions are read, applied or exported.

LLM sees only accessible bounded candidates and has no tools. Only existing identifiers and verified source substrings may produce proposals. Operator acceptance cannot silently overwrite manual data.
Normal work remains local and available without LLM. Unknown dates or fields remain empty; failed candidates do not invalidate valid candidates.
Archive completed C-PLAN-COMPOSITION-371 with terminal status only. Preserve existing uploaded DOCX template flow, authentication model, installer and dependencies.

NonGoals.NonGoal: General office-document editing, scheduled creation of plans, semantic merging of duplicate obligations, changing roles or publishing a release.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Title, term, optional executor and location are available; users can add text/date/number/select fields, preview the document and save a new template version.
Canonical extra fields persist across monthly plans; print overrides do not change source dates, ownership or calendar counts.

Selection returns visible recommended, review and other candidates with source reasons; approved selected rows are prefilled from server-saved grounded proposals with safe repeats and partial results.
Unsaved input survives errors and revision conflicts; late selection responses cannot affect a different month, template or draft.
DOCX contains the selected visible fields, order and values, checks required fields and pins exact field/template/source snapshots. Existing DOCX samples remain compatible.
Clean install, base upgrade, repeat, integrity, backup/verify/restore and forced migration failure recovery pass, along with focused API and desktop/mobile browser regression.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head CI, targeted desktop/mobile scenarios, database recovery and independent integration audit; no real-model-quality claim from HTTP fixtures.
